features.name: Field Service Integration
features.description: Integration between Dynamics 365 Field Service and Business Central enabling work order management, resource scheduling, and invoicing within Business Central.
caveats: Requires dataverse connection with sales and field service installed
Existing resource-product synchronization must be uncoupled

features.name: Work Order Synchronization
features.description: Synchronization of work order consumption data from field service to business Central project journals, with configurable timing for when work is marked as used and posting settings.
caveats: Requires project journal templates and batches to be designated
Field service invoice creation must be disabled

features.name: Resource Synchronization to Bookable Resources
features.description: Resources are synchronized from Business Central to bookable resources in field service to enable work order scheduling, replacing the previous product-based synchronization approach. Standard coupling actions are available including couple, delete coupling, match base coupling, and synchronize data.
caveats: Resources must have base unit of measure set to hours
Existing resource-product couplings may need to be uncoupled

features.name: Service Items Synchronization to Customer Assets
features.description: Service items from Business Central are synchronized to customer assets in field service to track operations on customer assets.

features.name: Project Task Integration with Work Orders
features.description: Project tasks are synchronized to enable consumption tracking and link work orders to specific business Central projects for postings and invoice creation. Standard coupling actions are available on project task cards, and users can create new work orders directly from project tasks with synchronized Business Central data.
caveats: Only project tasks of type posting are synchronized

features.name: Work Order Product and Service Mappings
features.description: Integration table mappings for work order products and work order services that bring data from field service work orders to business Central for consumption posting. Items of type inventory and non-inventory are synchronized from Business Central and can be picked in work order product lines. Service type items are synchronized as work order service lines.

features.name: Field Service Product Type Configuration
features.description: Products from Business Central must be configured with a field service product type field to be usable in field service, mapping to Business Central item types.
caveats: Field service product type must be manually configured by users
Not done automatically due to performance reasons and resource considerations

features.name: Assisted Setup Guide for Field Service Integration
features.description: Guided setup process that walks through enabling field service integration, configuring project journal templates and batches, setting hours unit of measure, and synchronization settings.
caveats: Requires dataverse connection with sales and field service to be pre-configured

features.name: Resource Booking for Work Orders
features.description: Users can book Business Central resources for specific work orders in Field Service. Resources are displayed in a resource scheduling interface and can be selected to perform work on scheduled work orders.

features.name: Work Order Consumption and Project Journal Integration
features.description: When work order products and services are marked as used in Field Service, the information is sent back to Business Central project journal templates and batches, enabling posting of consumption and invoicing against linked project tasks.

features.name: Work Order Invoicing from Project Journal
features.description: Project journal lines generated from consumed work order products and services can be converted into sales invoices. Posted sales invoices are automatically transferred back to Field Service as completion information.

features.name: Business Central Price List Transfer to Work Orders
features.description: Price lists from Business Central are transferred to Field Service work orders and can be selected to drive pricing for specific work orders.
